title: 锁版本也锁安装输入
premise: 选择候选客户端和插件组合，解析生产平台的完整依赖。
listeningTask: 辨别直接依赖固定与完整哈希锁定。

lines.en: We've generated hash-locked requirements for production. Direct and transitive versions are both fixed.
lines.zh: 已生成生产用带哈希锁依赖，直接与间接版本都固定了。

lines.en: Which interpreter and platform produced that lock? Keep those inputs under version control too.
lines.zh: 锁文件针对什么解释器和平台？这些输入也要版本管理。

lines.en: Python three twelve on our Linux image. Just to confirm, other platforms need validation, right?
lines.zh: Linux镜像上的Python 3.12，确认一下，其他平台另需验证，对吧？

lines.en: Okay, the dependency resolver output is attached. No hand-edited version exceptions in this approval.
lines.zh: 好，附上解析输出，本次审批不接受手工改版本例外。

lines.en: Check every artifact's hash during installation. Hashes verify identity, not package security alone.
lines.zh: 安装核对每个包的哈希，哈希验证身份，本身不证明包安全。

lines.en: I'm on it with the approved package mirror. Maybe we'll need to retain older wheels.
lines.zh: 批准的镜像源我来处理，可能也需保留旧wheel。

lines.en: Retain them for reproducible rollback builds. Pin the base image and installer version too.
lines.zh: 保留以便重建回退版本，也固定基础镜像与安装器。

lines.en: The lock becomes part of managed configuration. I'll stop production installs from resolving afresh.
lines.zh: 锁文件纳入受管配置，生产安装不能重新自由解析版本。

lines.en: Build inputs also include compiler toolchains. Prefer approved wheels where the platform supports them.
lines.zh: 构建输入还包括编译工具链，平台支持时优先批准的wheel。

lines.en: Make retaining inputs an explicit action item. The lock alone isn't our reproducibility claim.
lines.zh: 保留输入列为明确任务，不能只靠锁文件宣称可复现。

scene: 选择候选客户端和插件组合，解析生产平台的完整依赖。
accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）
